title: chore: Remove unused code related to parsing key-value pairs from CLI flags
body:
This custom `FlagStringKV` type was originally added in https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/commit/681d94ae207b0ff780642d68e98a518eb27eefce to enable parsing key-value pairs supplied via CLI flags.

Over time work like https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/pull/34886 replaced the use of logic in the flag_kv.go file with logic in other packages.

Currently no code uses the old `FlagStringKV` type and it's been overlooked for removal.
